metaDescription: Shopify store for Luscious Cosmetics, a Pakistani makeup brand: face, eyes, lips, brushes, lashes and nails, with routine add-ons, reviews and rewards.
summary: Shopify store for a Pakistani makeup brand selling face, eye and lip makeup, brushes, lashes and press-on nails.
overview: Luscious Cosmetics describes itself as Pakistan's first luxury makeup brand, cruelty-free and halal since 2007. We built the brand's Shopify store to carry its makeup, brushes, lashes, press-on nails and vanity cases, with a free gift on prepaid orders called out across the site.
challenge: The catalog mixes shade-based makeup such as lipsticks and brow pencils with tools, lashes and a growing range of press-on nails. Shoppers need to find bestsellers quickly, pick a shade, and see what else completes the look before they check out.
approach: A navy header with a pink announcement bar keeps the menu short: Shop All, Bestsellers, New & Trending, Clearance and Our Story, with a mega menu for face, eyes and brows, lips, brushes and tools, lashes and nails. The home page runs carousels for bestsellers, new arrivals and a tabbed World of Beauty Tools row. Product pages show the rating, sale price and campaign badge up front, then a Complete Your Routine block that adds matching products with one tick.
outcome: A Shopify store where shoppers can move from a campaign banner to a bestseller, choose a shade and add routine items in the same view. The same layout carries over to phones, with the menu, search and bag kept in a compact header.

results.label: Catalog
results.value: Makeup, brushes and tools, lashes, press-on nails

process.title: Menu and categories
process.body: A short top menu leads to Shop All, Bestsellers, New & Trending and Clearance, while the full range is grouped into face, eyes and brows, lips, brushes and tools, lashes and nails.

process.title: Home page rows
process.body: Campaign banners sit above carousels for bestsellers and new arrivals, then a World of Beauty Tools row with tabs for tools, bags, brushes, lashes and nails, followed by customer reviews and blog posts.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Each product shows its star rating, sale and original price, quantity and add to cart, then a Complete Your Routine box that suggests matching items with shade selectors.

process.title: Reviews and rewards
process.body: Judge.me reviews appear on product cards and pages, and a loyalty rewards program is built into the store alongside the free gift offer on prepaid orders.

whyItMatters: Makeup shoppers rarely buy one item at a time. Putting matching products and reviews right next to the add to cart button makes it easier to build a full look in one order.

faqs.q: What platform is the Luscious Cosmetics store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Horizon theme, using Shopify collections for makeup categories, bestsellers and new arrivals, with Judge.me reviews and a loyalty rewards app.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my beauty brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for makeup and beauty brands, including shade selection, routine add-ons and review integrations. Tell us about your range and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
